description: This file defines functions for comparing diff outputs, sanitizing diff data, and performing diff comparisons while ignoring certain heuristic differences. It appears to be a shell script used for testing or processing diff data within a version control or patch management system.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw
methods.description: Compares two diff files after sanitizing OID lines to ignore non-significant differences.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw_z
methods.description: Similar to compare_diff_raw but processes null characters and uses a different sanitization pattern.

methods.name: compare_diff_patch
methods.description: Compares two diff patches after removing certain lines that indicate metadata differences such as index hashes and similarity scores.
